hooks.command: $d=$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; if(-not $d){$d='.'}; $f=Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $d 'docs') -Filter 'handoff-*.md' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if($f){$b=Get-Content -Raw $f.FullName; $nl=[Environment]::NewLine; @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='SessionStart';additionalContext=('Latest team handoff ('+$f.Name+') - read this before starting work so you know what the team did recently:'+$nl+$nl+$b)}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress}
